oral_examination.oral_examination: 1. The face is slightly asymmetrical from left to right, with the right cheek being plump; the upper and lower lips are protruding on the side; the mandibular joint mobility on both sides is normal, the opening is three fingers horizontally, the opening is downward and middle, and there is no tenderness or snapping in the joint area; 2. Intraoral Permanent dentition, the upper and lower dental arches have rounded apices, and the anterior segments of the upper and lower dentitions are crowded; 3. Bilateral molars have a neutral relationship, the anterior teeth cover 8 mm deeply, the overbite is deep, and the midlines of the upper and lower dentitions are uneven; the upper and lower anterior teeth The lips are tilted; 4. Oral hygiene is average, and there is no obvious redness, swelling, abnormality or soft scale in the gums;
